scenes: Cover: heritage steam locomotive with deep forest-green cylindrical boiler, brass steam dome, black chimney and red chassis, THREE large red spoked driving wheels linked by metal rods on visible steel rails. Black coal tender directly behind, cream passenger coaches further behind. Three-quarter landscape sunny countryside, white steam cloud, no text numbers faces or logos.

Strict SIDE overview of SAME forest-green steam engine facing LEFT with black chimney at far-left, brass steam dome on long green boiler, cab rear-right and coal tender behind at far-right. Red spoked driving wheels sit ON two rails. Distinct visible targets chimney dome cab wheels tender, clear beige sky background.

Inside locomotive cab looking at open firebox door lower-center showing glowing orange coals and controlled flame behind heavy iron door rim. Adult fireman wearing blue overalls shovels black coal from heap on right INTO firebox. Human hands normal, no flame burning outside firebox, warm light and brass fittings.

Long SIDE cutaway of locomotive boiler: rear firebox at right contains fire, hot gases travel through metal fire tubes immersed IN blue water toward smokebox left. Water lower two-thirds, pale steam space ABOVE waterline inside pressure shell. Green outer shell peeled back, red frame and wheels below. Steam is inside boiler, no cartoon kettle.

Extreme close cutaway of brass steam dome atop forest-green boiler. Show dome as rounded closed pressure vessel connected openly below to upper boiler steam space; pale dense vapor filling inside above blue waterline visible lower area. No leaking hole on top, no flames inside dome. Leave blank upper-right for SVG pressure arrows.

Mechanical cylinder cutaway horizontal: large piston disk inside metal cylinder centered, straight piston rod exits to right through sealed gland. Pale steam admitted left of piston, clear cylinder walls and two end caps, no flames. Green frame behind softly, single teaching mechanism fills image; leave space for SVG motion arrows.

Close SIDE view mechanism at rail level: cylinder left connects straight piston rod to guided crosshead center-left, long diagonal connecting rod runs from crosshead to offset crankpin on ONE large red spoked driving wheel right. All joints touch, central axle distinct from offset pin, wheel sits on horizontal steel rail. No broken or floating rods.

Side closeup of three large red spoked driving wheels coupled by long steel rod between OFFSET CRANKPINS, not through central axles. Wheel tread contacts steel rail below, wooden sleepers and gravel ballast visible; green boiler cropped upper edge. No locomotive face or people.

Cab upper closeup: polished brass steam whistle mounted outside on cab roof upper-left emitting little white vapor, rope/cord descends through open cab to driver in blue cap pulling cord at right. Driver safely INSIDE cab, no head out in steam. Boiler below, green brass design consistent.

Low-angle closeup black chimney connected firmly to front of forest-green engine, gray exhaust mixed with white steam rising into open blue sky. Part of round smokebox and lamp visible beneath; countryside softbackground. Distinguish chimney opening, plume and engine body clearly.

Three-quarter CUTAWAY of black tender attached behind green cab at left. Coal piled in upper open bin; blue WATER shown in separate sealed lower and side tank compartments, black coal never submerged in water. Tender wheels rest on rails, metal coupling intact, distinct whole tender and two contents.

Wide joyful countryside journey: forest-green steam engine left-front travels on gentle curving rails with coal tender directly behind and cream passenger carriages following. Red spoked wheels on rails, white steam above, small green hills and a stone bridge distance. Full engine tender and smoke visible with no text.

Recap spacious cream-paper arrangement: dominant whole forest-green locomotive center with black chimney brass dome red driving wheels, small clearly separate boiler cross-section and piston-rod mechanism below corners. No labels or text, no arrows, engineering forms credible, locomotive sits on short rail segment.
